changes: Assigned-anchor analysis plots now orient the longer concentration series horizontally, keeping more columns than rows for two-drug layouts and three-drug slices.
Restored standard twofold dilutions in the 8 × 8 suggested repeat design: control plus seven positive levels per drug, with fitted ICxx labels.

Imported concentrations now use a 0.01% relative matching tolerance to combine near-equal dose levels consistently across analysis and DiaMOND layouts, while preserving response precision, zero doses, and assigned MICs and anchors.
Assigned-anchor layouts now show every two-drug concentration in one plot; three-drug layouts let you choose the drug and concentration used to page through the two-drug displays.
Added per-row Import exclusions and organized Dose Anchors by combination and organism with a plate preview of assigned doses, available response data, and the closest IC50-based reference cells.
DiaMOND now treats blank responses as unmeasured locations and omits them from fitting; numeric zero responses remain measured data.
DiaMOND dose-response point tooltips now show each drug’s absolute concentration in its imported units alongside normalized dose and inhibition.
Suggested experiment grids now show italic fitted ICxx labels beside concentration headers and display one organism–drug layout at a time with previous/next controls.
Click the version number in the header to view changes in each recorded version.
Dose Anchors now shows Closest Anchor, Maximum Dose Retention, and editable Assigned Dose Anchor columns, with buttons to copy either suggested set.
Check how many combination doses the assigned anchors retain before analysis, and see compatible anchors when too few doses remain.
Plan repeat experiments with concentration grids, single-agent rows and columns, rounded maximum concentrations, and exact twofold dilutions.
Repeat-layout anchors follow the rounded concentration ratio; extrapolated IC50 estimates are flagged as provisional.
Added Drusano–Greco fitting, count-data sampling, regimen simulation, and comparison.
Added MuSyC analysis and project save/load.
Added native DiaMOND analysis, dose-response plots, and regimen comparison.
Expanded native Bliss calculations and SynergyFinder compatibility checks.
Improved regimen comparison, bootstrap results, and workbook export.
Introduced the self-contained Tauri desktop app with React and native Rust assay analysis.
